checkout.doc: config/holon.json's key path of the checkout: the sealed target's (a clone of the sealed repository at the sealed commit, fetched only as spec/heldout/target.json pins it). Not sealed: this target names no seal, so the sealed target stays the one target that does. rerun_of: the target whose committed result this one reruns; contaminated: the label every number of the rerun carries. Not the development target.

doc: I50b's contaminated rerun of the held-out target (spec/M4/lib/heldout_rerun.json rule T1b): the sealed target's description (targets/scroll/target.json) with its paths moved here, the seal keys left out, and the rerun's sidecar rules. Its documents are the pinned Solidity frontend's output over the same checkout, under a scope sidecar at sidecar_version 2 (rule D1); its laws are derived with the typed-sorts sidecar at holon-sort-types/0.2 (rules U1-U3). Both changes were made after the seal opened, so every number here is labelled: contaminated (post-seal change). The sealed target's result is the result of record.

extract.doc: the pinned Solidity frontend with the rerun's scope sidecar (the sealed one at sidecar_version 2) over the checkout; holon target extract writes the document and the extraction report gen/targets/scroll_i50b/extraction.json

index.doc: as the sealed target's: the typed run's dependency index is not built; drift on this target compares documents only

name: scroll_i50b

run.doc: I50b: I50's route (the pinned catalog's laws over the target's document, derived and decided as the typed test milestone T50 in a scratch root) with the sidecars of rules Q1b-Q4b of sidecar_rules; labelled contaminated

upstream.pinned_refs_doc: the upstream's tags (each at its peeled commit) as git ls-remote listed them when this file was written (I49, 2026-11-11); the sealed commit is the peeled commit of refs/tags/v4.0.0. A tag added or moved after this snapshot is drift.
